title: Multi-Estimate Elicitation Does Not Uniformly Debias Language Model Judgments
abstract: arXiv:2611.00597v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Does eliciting five weighted estimates within a single response change how a language model responds to information? Across anchoring, hindsight, base-rate, conjunction, and status-quo/default tasks, we compare direct numerical answers with a multi-estimate response format, contrasting source framings, explicitly random cues, and probability-consistency constraints. We evaluate three completed configurations--gpt-6.1-sol, claude-sonnet-5.5, and Qwen3-8B (reasoning disabled, analyzed descriptively). In the first two configurations, direct elicitation yielded near-zero irrelevant-anchor indices and status-quo effects, while remaining responsive to informative sources and informed advice. Of 23 preregistered confirmatory tests, six rejected after Holm adjustment; however, all six absolute point estimates fell below their prespecified smallest effect sizes of interest without establishing equivalence. translated_title: 多重估计引导并不能统一地消除语言模型判断中的偏差
translated_abstract: 在单次回复中引导模型给出五个加权估计值，是否会改变语言模型对信息的响应方式？在锚定、后见之明、基础比率、合取以及现状/默认等任务中，我们将直接数值回答与多重估计响应格式进行对比，同时比较了不同的来源框架、显式随机线索以及概率一致性约束。我们评估了三种已完成配置——gpt-6.1-sol、claude-sonnet-5.5 以及 Qwen3-8B（禁用推理，进行描述性分析）。在前两种配置中，直接引导产生的无关锚定指数和现状效应接近于零，同时模型仍能对信息性来源和知情建议保持敏感。在23项预注册的验证性测试中，有六项在经过 Holm 校正后被拒绝；然而，这六项测试的绝对点估计值均低于预先设定的最小感兴趣效应量，但并未据此建立等效性结论。此外，虽然分离引导与联合引导的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究通过预注册实验发现，在单次回复中引导语言模型给出多个加权估计值的格式并不能统一地消除其认知偏差，在锚定和现状等任务中偏差效应已接近于零，尽管多项效应量低于预设的最小感兴趣效应量，但并未能确立统计等效性。
en_tdlr: This preregistered study shows that eliciting multiple weighted estimates within a single response does not uniformly debias language model judgments—anchoring and status-quo effects were near zero, and although several effects fell below prespecified smallest effect sizes of interest, statistical equivalence was not established.
